Trace, implement and test: leetcode318 maximum product of word lengths bit operation with hashmap

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<string>
#include<unordered_map>
#include<unordered_set>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int maxProduct(vector<string>& words) {
        unordered_map<int, int> maxlen; // 映射: one word's bit mask -> current largest word length
        for (string word : words)
        {
            int mask = 0;
            for (const char& ch : word)
                mask |= 1 << (ch - 'a');
            maxlen[mask] = max(maxlen[mask], (int) word.size());
        }
        int result = 0;
        for (auto& kv1 : maxlen)
        {
            for (auto& kv2 : maxlen)
            {
                if (!(kv1.first & kv2.first))
                    result = max(result, kv1.second * kv2.second);                        
            }    
        }
        return result;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<string> s = {"abcw", "baz", "foo", "bar", "xtfn", "abcdef", "foo"};
    auto res = sol.maxProduct(s);
    // 预期输出结果为: 16
    cout << res << endl;
        
    return 0;
}
